title: prez's example deck trips prez's own class warning, on every theme, on every build
body:
prez's own example deck applies a slide class no built-in theme declares, so
`prez build examples/demo.md` emits a warning for every theme, on every build.

Observed by hv while rendering all seven built-ins for ST0010/AC16:

    prez: warning: class 'escape' has no effect: the built-in '8bit' does not
    style it. Every theme is expected to declare: title, section, quote, full,
    center, small

Seven builds, seven warnings, one per theme.

WHERE IT COMES FROM. `examples/demo.md:63` carries `<!-- class: escape -->` on
the slide titled "The escape hatch" -- the slide demonstrating that raw HTML
passes through untouched. The class is flavour matching the slide's title; it
styles nothing and was never meant to.

THE WARNING IS CORRECT. `theme.rs:133` pins the six classes a theme is expected
to declare -- title, section, quote, full, center, small -- and `simple`'s
stylesheet declares exactly those six and nothing else. `escape` genuinely has
no effect in any of the seven, so `deck.rs:241` is telling the truth.

WHY IT IS A DEFECT RATHER THAN NOISE. The canonical example deck is what a new
user renders first and what the README points at. Shipping it in a state that
trips the tool's own warning teaches the reader that the warning is background
noise to be ignored -- and the next deck that trips it for a real reason gets
the identical line and nobody looks. Same shape as Intent 0282: a warning that
always fires stops being a signal.

FIX: delete the `<!-- class: escape -->` line. The slide renders identically
without it -- its point is the raw HTML block below, not the class.

REJECTED ALTERNATIVE: adding an `escape` class to all seven themes. That
invents a styling concern nobody asked for to justify one line of flavour text,
and widens the standard set from six to seven for a class with no behaviour.

MEASURED BEFORE THE FIX, so the cost is known rather than predicted: three
suites consume demo.md -- acceptance.sh (ST0010, frozen), theme-addressing.sh
(ST0013) and at12-determinism-probe.mjs. Nothing anywhere asserts on the
`escape` class or on the warning text. Baselines taken green at 7/0/0 and
14/0/0/0.
